split: DEV only; all 50 invoice and 10 bank pages
rationale: Own hypotheses: asymmetric detector/recognizer capacity and full-width overlapping strip detection inspired by modular PP-OCRv6 and SAHI. Not exact reproductions of either paper. No thresholds fit to the reference labels.
selection_rule: Report all modes. Consider shipping only after Rust/WASM parity and fixed-input regressions; no automatic default replacement. Report token recall with precision and full-field exact counts. Native unpaired time is descriptive only.
